name: filemaker-data-api-tools
description: Query, edit, and explore FileMaker data without leaving VS Code. Full CRUD for fmrest, visual query builder, schema diffing, batch import/export, and TypeScript type generation for Claris FileMaker Server and FileMaker Cloud.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reading layout metadata, browsing the FileMaker Explorer, and running Find queries work in untrusted workspaces. Write operations (record edit/create/delete, batch updates, type generation, FM Web project init) and enterprise environment comparisons require a trusted workspace. Trust the workspace via VS Code's banner to enable them.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No FileMaker connections yet.
[Add Connection Profile](command:filemakerDataApiTools.addConnectionProfile)
[Open Walkthrough](command:filemakerDataApiTools.openWelcomeWalkthrough)

Your passwords stay in the OS keychain. Learn more in the [User Guide](command:filemakerDataApiTools.openUserGuide).

Select a layout in Connections or choose one directly.
[Select Layout](command:filemakerDataApiTools.selectLayoutForInspector)
[Connect](command:filemakerDataApiTools.connect)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with FileMaker Data API Tools
walkthroughs.description: Connect to FileMaker, run a query, inspect a layout, and generate typed code.

steps.title: Add a connection profile
steps.description:
Tell the extension how to reach your FileMaker server. Passwords go to the OS keychain — they never touch your workspace files.
[Add Profile](command:filemakerDataApiTools.addConnectionProfile)

steps.title: Connect and verify
steps.description:
Open a session against the Data API. Transient failures retry with exponential backoff and the token refreshes proactively before expiry.
[Connect](command:filemakerDataApiTools.connect)

steps.title: Run your first query
steps.description:
Pick a layout and build a find with the form: choose a field, a condition, and a value. Results open in a sortable table; double-click a row to open the record.
[Open Query Builder](command:filemakerDataApiTools.openQueryBuilder)

steps.title: Inspect a layout
steps.description:
See a layout's fields, portals, value lists, and field validation in the Layout Inspector, then capture a schema snapshot to track changes over time.
[Select Layout](command:filemakerDataApiTools.selectLayoutForInspector)

steps.title: Generate typed code
steps.description:
Turn layout metadata into TypeScript types, a typed client, or editor snippets for your own project.
[Generate Types for Layout](command:filemakerDataApiTools.generateTypesForLayout)

filemaker.requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for FileMaker Data API requests. Replaces the deprecated `filemakerDataApiTools.requestTimeoutMs`.

filemaker.defaultApiBasePath.description: Default API base path used when a profile does not override it. Replaces the deprecated `filemakerDataApiTools.defaultApiBasePath`.

filemaker.defaultApiVersionPath.description: Default FileMaker Data API version segment used when a profile does not override it. Replaces the deprecated `filemakerDataApiTools.defaultApiVersionPath`.

filemaker.connect.maxRetries.description: Number of retries the FileMaker connect command performs on transient login failures (network errors, 5xx). 0 disables retry.

filemaker.connect.backoffInitialMs.description: Initial delay (ms) before the first retry of a failed connect.

filemaker.connect.backoffMaxMs.description: Maximum delay (ms) the connect backoff will wait between retries.

filemaker.connect.backoffMultiplier.description: Exponential multiplier applied to the connect backoff delay between retries.

filemaker.connectionWizard.requireTestBe.description: Whether the connection wizard requires a successful Test Connection before Save. 'off' = no requirement; 'warn' = save with confirmation when untested or edits since last test; 'block' = save disabled until a successful test on the current values.

filemaker.session.maxAgeMinutes.description: Treat the FileMaker Data API session token as expired after this many minutes from issuance. Default 14 (FM tokens nominally expire at 15).

filemaker.session.refreshLeadSeconds.description: Refresh the session token proactively when this many seconds remain before nominal expiry. Set to 0 to disable proactive refresh and rely on 401-retry only.

filemaker.secrets.fallback.description: Behavior when VS Code SecretStorage is unavailable. 'vscode-only' (default) propagates the error. 'workspace-state' encrypts secrets to workspace state for headless / remote-agent setups. 'disabled' skips secret persistence entirely (development only).

filemaker.savedQueries.scope.description: Scope used to store saved queries.

filemaker.history.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of request history entries stored per workspace.

filemaker.snippets.includeAuthByDefault.description: Whether generated curl/fetch snippets include authorization headers by default.

filemaker.features.scriptRunner.enabled.description: Enable Script Runner UI and script execution features.

filemaker.scripts.parameterBuilder.enabl.description: Enable the Script Runner JSON parameter builder.

filemaker.batch.maxRecords.description: Safety cap for batch export record count.

filemaker.batch.concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent write operations for batch update execution.

filemaker.batch.dryRunDefault.description: Default dry-run mode for batch updates.

filemaker.containerUploadMaxBytes.description: Maximum file size, in bytes, allowed by FileMaker: Upload to Container. Default is 100 MB.

filemaker.features.batch.enabled.description: Enable batch export/update features (auto-disabled in untrusted workspaces).

filemaker.performance.mode.description: High-scale mode optimizes batch/export workflows for large datasets.

filemaker.schema.cacheTtlSeconds.description: Schema metadata cache TTL in seconds.

filemaker.schema.metadataEnabled.description: Enable layout metadata lookups for schema/field browsing.

filemaker.schema.snapshots.storage.description: Storage backend for schema snapshots. In untrusted workspaces, workspaceState is used automatically.

filemaker.schema.snapshots.maxPerLayout.description: Maximum number of schema snapshots to retain per layout. Oldest snapshots are pruned automatically.

filemaker.schema.diagnostics.enabled.description: Publish schema diff changes to the Problems panel when diffing against latest snapshot.

filemaker.schema.hashAlgorithm.description: Hash algorithm used for schema metadata fingerprinting.

filemaker.typegen.outputDir.description: Workspace output folder for generated TypeScript layout types.

filemaker.fmWeb.bridge.rateLimitPerSecon.description: Sustained requests-per-second cap on the local FM bridge server. Throttled requests get HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Default 20.

filemaker.fmWeb.bridge.rateLimitBurst.description: Burst capacity for the bridge token bucket — max requests permitted in a single instant. Default 60.

filemaker.fmWeb.bridge.requestBudget.description: Hard cap on total bridge requests per session token. After exhaustion, restart the bridge to reset. Default 10000.

filemaker.offline.mode.description: Use cached metadata only and disable write operations.

filemaker.offline.staleCacheWarnHours.description: Hours after which the schema metadata cache is considered stale. The status bar shows a warning and a one-time toast is emitted. Set to 0 to disable the stale-cache warning.

filemaker.enterprise.mode.description: Enable enterprise governance controls and role-based feature gating.

filemaker.enterprise.role.description: Enterprise role used for feature access control.

filemakerDataApiTools.logLevel.description: Minimum log level written to the FileMaker Data API Tools output channel.

filemakerDataApiTools.requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for FileMaker Data API requests.

filemakerDataApiTools.defaultApiBasePath.description: Default API base path used when a profile does not override it.

filemakerDataApiTools.defaultApiVersionP.description: Default FileMaker Data API version segment used when a profile does not override it.

filemaker.advanced.powerUserMode.markdownDescription: Surface diagnostic / plugin / circuit-breaker / job-runner / import-export commands in the Command Palette. Off by default to keep the FileMaker palette focused on commands new users actually need.

filemaker.logging.level.description: Minimum logging level for FileMaker Data API Tools output.

filemaker.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable anonymous usage telemetry to help improve the extension. No personal data or FileMaker credentials are collected.
